queries: Sarah Friar OpenAI blog annualized revenue 2025 "20B" business that scales with the value of intelligence

sources_considered.why: Reuters report of the OpenAI CFO's revenue figures. Used as context.

receipt.public_excerpt: Chief Financial Officer Sarah Friar said in a blog post on Sunday ​the company's annualized revenue has surpassed $20 billion ‌in 2025, up from $6 billion in 2024

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI's annualized run rate roughly tripled in 2025, as the company reports it. That cuts against a strong version of the claim, but it is a run rate, not recognized revenue, and it cannot show what growth would have been without price competition.

unresolved_gaps: No baseline for what OpenAI's revenue would have been without price competition, so 'hamper' cannot be measured.
The figures available are run rates the company reported itself, not audited recognized revenue.
